# GitHub Copilot Instructions

For every non-trivial change to product behavior, routes, UI, layout, components, design tokens, or accessibility, read and follow [specification/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md](../specification/AI_INSTRUCTIONS.md) before editing. It is the canonical source for baseline discovery, pre-implementation specification updates, implementation, testing, screenshot evidence, and post-verification documentation updates.

Do not assume a route, registry entry, menu item, screenshot, or old proposal proves current functionality. Inspect the active branch's source, tests, current-state baseline and approved target specification. Keep code, documentation, and approved SVG/PNG target assets synchronized. Report tests that were not run as unverified.
